name: StormBurger
facts: Two StormBurger locations are open: Inglewood and Long Beach. A third, in Compton, is coming soon.
Inglewood: 1500 N La Brea Ave, Inglewood, CA 90302. Open Sun–Thu 10:30 AM–12 AM and Fri–Sat 10:30 AM–1 AM.
Long Beach: 5801 Cherry Ave, Long Beach, CA 90805. Open Mon–Wed 10:30 AM–10 PM and Thu–Sun 10:30 AM–11 PM.
Compton (coming soon): 336 W Alondra Blvd, Compton, CA 90220.
You earn 20 reward points for every $1 you spend.
Reward ladder: 1,000 pts = Free fries, 1,800 = Free shake, 3,000 = Free Classic StormBurger, 4,500 = Free combo.
Bonus points: 50 for a daily visit check-in, 100 for your first order, 200 for your birthday, 250 for in-app feedback.
The Daily Spin is free: one spin per member per day (Los Angeles time), and every slice wins something.
Storm Run is the app's driving game. It has 10 levels of 90 seconds each and you get 5 lives.
Storm Run is free to play with no account. You only need a free account to save a score or claim a prize.
Swipe left or right (or tap a side of the screen) to change lanes. On a computer, use the ◀ ▶ arrow keys.
Every hit costs half a life, so 10 hits total the truck.
Coins are +10. Food is +30 to +60. Flying cows, stop signs and lightning cost −100 and half a life.
Sample weekly prize: the top score from Monday through Sunday close wins a Free Double Classic StormBurger Combo.
Score prizes in one run: 400 = free house sauce, 600 = free fries or onion rings, 800 = free milkshake, 1,000 = free Classic StormBurger.
The weekly board resets every Monday. Ties go to the score posted first.
Prizes are samples. StormBurger picks the real ones.
Only one game prize at a time per member, and prizes must be used within 3 days.
Daily Spin food prizes and discounts are good for 3 days at either location, one reward per visit.
Combos include fries and a soft drink. Swap fries for onion rings (+$2.00) or the drink for a milkshake (+$2.00).
Sauces are homemade and cost $1.00 each.
The Order Inglewood and Order Long Beach buttons are at the top of the app, and each location has a Directions button.
One free member account per person and per phone. It needs a name, phone number and email.
You must be 13 or older to play for prizes. Players under 18 need a parent's or guardian's permission.
Your info is used only for your rewards account and is never sold.
Marketing texts and emails are opt-in. Reply STOP or unsubscribe any time.
Staff can help at the counter. The app shows no phone number for StormBurger.
The app can be translated into many languages using the 🌐 menu.
You can add the app to your Home Screen from your browser.
Near a StormBurger, the app offers: show it at the counter for double stars on today's order.
StormBurger's Instagram is @stormburger.
Refer a friend: you get 150 points when they join, plus 100 for their first order and 25 for each order after.
Your friend gets 50 points and free fries when they join with your code.
suggested: How do I play Storm Run and win prizes?
How does the Daily Spin work?

qa.q: What are your hours?
qa.a: Inglewood: Sun–Thu 10:30 AM–12 AM, Fri–Sat 10:30 AM–1 AM. Long Beach: Mon–Wed 10:30 AM–10 PM, Thu–Sun 10:30 AM–11 PM.

qa.q: What time does the Inglewood location open and close?
qa.a: Inglewood is open 10:30 AM to 12 AM Sunday through Thursday, and 10:30 AM to 1 AM on Friday and Saturday.

qa.q: What time does the Long Beach location open and close?
qa.a: Long Beach is open 10:30 AM to 10 PM Monday through Wednesday, and 10:30 AM to 11 PM Thursday through Sunday.

qa.q: Are you open late?
qa.a: Inglewood is open until 12 AM Sunday–Thursday and until 1 AM on Friday and Saturday. Long Beach closes at 10 PM Monday–Wednesday and 11 PM Thursday–Sunday.

qa.q: Are you open on Sunday?
qa.a: Yes. Inglewood is open Sunday 10:30 AM to 12 AM, and Long Beach is open Sunday 10:30 AM to 11 PM.

qa.q: Are you open on Monday?
qa.a: Yes. Inglewood is open 10:30 AM to 12 AM and Long Beach is open 10:30 AM to 10 PM.

qa.q: Are you open on Friday and Saturday?
qa.a: Yes. Inglewood is open 10:30 AM to 1 AM both days. Long Beach is open 10:30 AM to 11 PM both days.

qa.q: Where are you located?
qa.a: Inglewood: 1500 N La Brea Ave, Inglewood, CA 90302. Long Beach: 5801 Cherry Ave, Long Beach, CA 90805. A Compton spot is coming soon.

qa.q: What is the Inglewood address?
qa.a: 1500 N La Brea Ave, Inglewood, CA 90302.

qa.q: What is the Long Beach address?
qa.a: 5801 Cherry Ave, Long Beach, CA 90805.

qa.q: Is there a Compton location?
qa.a: Compton is coming soon at 336 W Alondra Blvd, Compton, CA 90220. I don't have an opening date.

qa.q: How do I get directions?
qa.a: Tap the 📍 Directions button under the location you want, either Inglewood or Long Beach.

qa.q: Where can I park?
qa.a: I don't have parking details. Please ask staff at the location.

qa.q: Do you have a drive-thru?
qa.a: I don't have that detail. Please ask staff at your location.

qa.q: What is your phone number?
qa.a: The app doesn't show a phone number for StormBurger. Please ask staff at the counter.

qa.q: How do I contact StormBurger?
qa.a: Ask staff at the counter. You can also find StormBurger on Instagram at @stormburger.

qa.q: How do I order?
qa.a: Tap ⚡ Order Inglewood or ⚡ Order Long Beach at the top of the app. You can also build your own burger or chicken sandwich in the app's builder.

qa.q: Can I order from my table with a QR code?
qa.a: I don't have details on table QR ordering. Use the order buttons in the app, or ask staff.

qa.q: How do I pay?
qa.a: I don't have payment details. Please ask staff at your location.

qa.q: Can I build my own burger?
qa.a: Yes. The app has a "Build your burger" section where you pick your patties, cheese, toppings and extras and see the price add up. Then you place the order.

qa.q: What does the burger builder start at?
qa.a: The smash burger base is $2.74 for a brioche bun and Storm sauce. Patties and extras are added on top.

qa.q: How much do patties and extras cost in the builder?
qa.a: A 4oz smash patty is $2.50 (up to 3). American or Swiss cheese is $0.75 each, bacon is $2.00, and jalapeños are $1.00. Lettuce, tomato, onion, pickles and onion straws are free.

qa.q: Can I build a chicken sandwich?
qa.a: Yes. Use the 🐔 Chicken sandwich tab in the builder. The base is $2.00 for a brioche bun and mayo, and the crispy fillet is $4.99. A spicy Thunder fillet is also $4.99.

qa.q: What is on the menu?
qa.a: The app lists combos, burgers, a chicken sandwich, a Kids Burger, a Turkey Burger, milkshakes and homemade sauces. Scroll to "The menu" in the app to see everything.

qa.q: How much is the Classic StormBurger Combo?
qa.a: $11.99, with the Classic StormBurger, fries and a soft drink.

qa.q: What is the Jalapeño Lightning Burger?
qa.a: It has homemade avocado crema, Storm sauce, a 4oz patty, Swiss cheese, grilled onions and jalapeños. It's $6.99, or $13.99 as a combo.

qa.q: Do you have a kids menu?
qa.a: Yes. The Kids Burger (4oz patty, American cheese) is $5.99. The Kids Combo adds fries and a soft drink for $11.99.

qa.q: Do you have a chicken sandwich?
qa.a: Yes. The Chicken Sandwich Combo is $12.99 with fries and a soft drink.

qa.q: Do you have a turkey burger?
qa.a: Yes. The Turkey Burger has two 2oz turkey patties, lettuce, tomato, cheese, onions, pickles and burger sauce. It's $6.99.

qa.q: Do you have milkshakes?
qa.a: Yes. The Mix Shake ("Why not both?") is $4.99. Vanilla and chocolate shakes are also available.

qa.q: What sauces do you have?
qa.a: Homemade sauces are $1.00 each, including Storm (the signature burger sauce), BBQ, Honey Mustard and Spicy Mayo. Thunder and Ranch also show up in the app.

qa.q: What does a combo include?
qa.a: All combos come with fries and a soft drink.

qa.q: Can I upgrade to onion rings or a shake?
qa.a: Yes. Upgrade fries to onion rings for +$2.00, or your drink to a milkshake for +$2.00.

qa.q: Do you have onion rings?
qa.a: Yes, onion rings are on the menu. They also show up as a combo upgrade (+$2.00) and as a game prize.

qa.q: Do you have lemonade?
qa.a: Lemonade appears in the Storm Run game. I don't have its price or menu details, so please ask staff.

qa.q: Do you have chicken strips?
qa.a: Chicken strips appear in the game and in the seasonal specials. I don't have regular menu details, so please ask staff.

qa.q: Do you have holiday specials?
qa.a: Yes, the app lists seasonal specials. Next up is the Gobble Burger (a Turkey Burger with Onion Rings) from Nov 20 to Nov 28.

qa.q: What specials are coming up?
qa.a: Gobble Burger Nov 20–28, Holiday Shake Stack Dec 15–25, New Year BBQ Combo Dec 29–Jan 1, Burgers for Two Feb 7–14, Lucky Strips Combo Mar 14–17, Cinco Spicy Combo May 1–5, and Fourth of July Classic Jul 1–4.

qa.q: What is the Holiday Shake Stack?
qa.a: It's a Double Classic StormBurger with a Mix Shake (vanilla and chocolate), available Dec 15–25.

qa.q: What is the Burgers for Two special?
qa.a: Two Classic StormBurgers and one Chocolate Shake with two straws, available Feb 7–14.

qa.q: Do you have a happy hour?
qa.a: I don't have happy hour details. Please ask staff.

qa.q: How do I join StormBurger Rewards?
qa.a: Create a free member account with your name, phone number and email. The app also shows a join card, and you can join when you save a game prize or score.

qa.q: Do I need an account to play the game?
qa.a: No. Storm Run is free to play with no account. You only need a free member account to save your score or claim a prize.

qa.q: Is it free to join?
qa.a: Yes. The member account and the game are free, and no purchase is necessary to play, spin or win.

qa.q: Can I have more than one account?
qa.a: No. It's one free member account per person and per phone. Scores made with multiple accounts are disqualified.

qa.q: How old do I have to be?
qa.a: You must be 13 or older. Players under 18 need a parent's or guardian's permission.

qa.q: How do I earn points?
qa.a: You earn 20 points per $1 you spend, plus bonuses like a daily visit check-in, a first-order bonus, a birthday bonus, in-app feedback and referrals. The Daily Spin can also give you points.

qa.q: How many points do I get per dollar?
qa.a: You earn 20 points for every $1 you spend.

qa.q: How many points do I get for visiting?
qa.a: You get 50 bonus points for showing your QR on a new day (once a day), on top of the points for your purchase.

qa.q: Is there a bonus for my first order?
qa.a: Yes. Your very first order earns a 100-point bonus.

qa.q: How do I get my points added after I pay?
qa.a: Show your member QR or code to the cashier so they can add your purchase. You can also type the code from your receipt.

qa.q: What can I get with my points?
qa.a: 1,000 points = Free fries, 1,800 = Free shake, 3,000 = Free Classic StormBurger, 4,500 = Free combo.

qa.q: How many points for free fries?
qa.a: 1,000 points gets you Free fries.

qa.q: How many points for a free shake?
qa.a: 1,800 points gets you a Free shake.

qa.q: How many points for a free burger?
qa.a: 3,000 points gets you a Free Classic StormBurger.

qa.q: How many points for a free combo?
qa.a: 4,500 points gets you a Free combo.

qa.q: How do I redeem a reward?
qa.a: Pick a reward in the app once you have enough points, then show it at StormBurger so staff can apply it.

qa.q: Do points expire?
qa.a: I don't have expiry details for points. Game and spin food prizes must be used within 3 days. Please ask staff about points.

qa.q: Do points have cash value?
qa.a: No. Points have no cash value and can only be traded for the rewards listed in the app.

qa.q: Is there a birthday reward?
qa.a: Yes. You get 200 bonus points for your birthday when your birthday is on your member account.

qa.q: Can I earn points for giving feedback?
qa.a: Yes. In-app feedback earns 250 points. Google or Yelp reviews don't earn points or prizes.

qa.q: Is there a referral program?
qa.a: Yes. When a friend joins with your code you earn 150 points. You also earn 100 points on their first order and 25 on each order after that.

qa.q: What does my friend get when I refer them?
qa.a: Your friend gets 50 points and a free fries when they join with your code.

qa.q: Are there loyalty levels or tiers?
qa.a: I don't have details on member levels. Your points go toward the rewards ladder (fries at 1,000 up to a free combo at 4,500).

qa.q: Is there a bonus when I'm near the restaurant?
qa.a: Yes. If you allow location, the app can tell you when you're nearby and show an offer: show it at the counter for double stars on today's order. Your location stays on your phone.

qa.q: Is there an early-bird bonus?
qa.a: I don't have early-bird details. The visit check-in gives 50 points once a day.

qa.q: What is the Daily Spin?
qa.a: It's a free wheel you can spin once a day as a member, and every slice wins something. Prizes include points, free house sauce, free fries, $2 off any burger and 10% off your order.

qa.q: How often can I spin the wheel?
qa.a: Once per member per day, by Los Angeles time. Spins are never sold and can't be earned by buying anything.

qa.q: What can I win on the Daily Spin?
qa.a: +100 points (30%), +200 points (20%), +150 points (15%), free house sauce (15%), $2 off any burger (8%), free fries (7%) and 10% off your order (5%).

qa.q: Do spin prizes expire?
qa.a: Food prizes and discounts from the spin are good for 3 days at Inglewood or Long Beach. It's one reward per visit and they can't be combined with other rewards.

qa.q: What is Storm Run?
qa.a: It's StormBurger's driving game. You steer a food truck from Inglewood to Long Beach, grabbing coins and StormBurger food while dodging lightning, flying cows, stop signs, police and tornadoes.

qa.q: How do I play Storm Run?
qa.a: Swipe left or right on the road to change lanes, or tap the left or right side to move one lane. On a computer, use the ◀ ▶ arrow keys. Grab food and coins, and dodge everything else.

qa.q: How long is a game?
qa.a: A run has 10 levels of 90 seconds each. You have 5 lives, and the first 10 seconds are calm so you can get the feel of it.

qa.q: How do lives work in Storm Run?
qa.a: You have 5 lives and every hit costs half a life, so 10 hits total the truck. Pit stops can repair it.

qa.q: How does scoring work in Storm Run?
qa.a: Coins are +10 and food is +30 to +60. Flying cows, stop signs and lightning cost −100 and half a life. You also get a level bonus of 100 points times the new level number.

qa.q: How many points is each food worth in the game?
qa.a: Classic StormBurger and Turkey Burger +60, Chicken Sandwich and Chicken Strips +50, Vanilla Shake and Lemonade +40, Fries and Onion Rings +30.

qa.q: What should I dodge in Storm Run?
qa.a: Dodge lightning (move off the glowing target), flying cows, stop signs, police cars (▲ arrows show their lane), roadblocks, spike strips, the drive-thru line and tornadoes. Tornadoes always come with a warning and a red lane.

qa.q: What happens if a tornado hits me?
qa.a: A tornado hit costs about 25% of your score, at least 200 points. A "TORNADO WARNING" and a red lane show first so you can move.

qa.q: What is the Jordan High pit stop?
qa.a: On some levels you can pull into the Jordan High pit bay. The run pauses and you tap ingredients in order to build burgers for the students. Each burger gives +75 points and repairs +1 life.

qa.q: What are Antidote Drizzle coins?
qa.a: They're gold coins worth +25 each. Catch 5 in a run and a review billboard appears on the road. Drive through its golden ▶ to find Antidote's StormBurger review for a +500 bonus.

qa.q: Can I turn the sound off in the game?
qa.a: Yes. Tap the 🔊 Sound button on the game screen to turn sound on or off. A 🎵 button switches between songs.

qa.q: Can I play with a game controller?
qa.a: Yes. A controller connects through your browser. Left and right on the stick or D-pad change lanes.

qa.q: Can I switch between 3D and 2D in the game?
qa.a: Yes. Open the game menu's Settings and choose View: 3D chase cam or Classic 2D. You can also change Graphics quality there.

qa.q: How often can I play Storm Run?
qa.a: As often as you like. It's free and there's no limit on plays.

qa.q: What prizes can I win in Storm Run?
qa.a: One run over 400 points wins a free house sauce, 600 a free fries or onion rings, 800 a free milkshake, and 1,000 a free Classic StormBurger. These are sample prizes, and StormBurger picks the real ones.

qa.q: How do I win a free Classic StormBurger from the game?
qa.a: Score over 1,000 points in a single run.

qa.q: How do I win a free milkshake from the game?
qa.a: Score 800 or more in one run. You can pick vanilla, chocolate or mix.

qa.q: How do I win free fries or onion rings from the game?
qa.a: Score 600 or more in one run. It comes with any order.

qa.q: How do I win a free house sauce from the game?
qa.a: Score 400 or more in one run. Pick Storm, Thunder, Ranch and more.

qa.q: How do I claim a game prize?
qa.a: After your run, tap Save my prize and join with your name, phone and email. Your code shows in the app. Show it at StormBurger to redeem within 3 days.

qa.q: Can I win more than one game prize?
qa.a: Only one prize at a time per member. If you already have one waiting, use it first and then your next win saves.

qa.q: How does the weekly leaderboard work?
qa.a: The highest score from Monday through Sunday close is the weekly champion. The board resets every Monday, and ties go to the score posted first.

qa.q: What does the weekly champion win?
qa.a: A Free Double Classic StormBurger Combo for the top score by Sunday close. It's a sample prize, and StormBurger picks the real one.

qa.q: When does the weekly board reset?
qa.a: Every Monday.

qa.q: When are weekly prizes picked?
qa.a: The weekly top score is decided at Sunday close, and the board starts fresh Monday. I don't have more detail on how winners are contacted, so ask staff.

qa.q: Is my best score saved?
qa.a: Your best score is saved on your phone, shown as "Your best" on the game screen. To rank on the weekly board, save your score with a member account.

qa.q: Do I have to buy something to play or win?
qa.a: No. No purchase or payment of any kind is necessary to play Storm Run, spin the Daily Spin, or win, and a purchase doesn't improve your chances.

qa.q: Can cheating disqualify me?
qa.a: Yes. Scores made with cheats, scripts, bots or multiple accounts are disqualified.

qa.q: What is the video that plays during a break?
qa.a: After about 90 seconds of total play, a short "Halftime" video with Antidote's StormBurger review may play. You can skip it or tap to watch the full review on YouTube.

qa.q: Is there trivia or sports in the app?
qa.a: I don't have any trivia or sports features listed for StormBurger. The app has the menu, the Storm Run game, the Daily Spin and rewards.

qa.q: What languages does the app support?
qa.a: Use the 🌐 menu to translate the app. The list includes English, Spanish, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Korean, Tagalog, Vietnamese, Armenian, Persian, Japanese, Thai and Russian.

qa.q: How do I add the app to my phone's Home Screen?
qa.a: On iPhone, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen, then Add. On Android, tap Install app, or use the ⋮ menu and choose Add to Home screen.

qa.q: Is there a wallet card?
qa.a: I don't have wallet card details. You can add the app to your Home Screen so your rewards are one tap away.

qa.q: Is there a kid mode?
qa.a: I don't have a kid mode listed. The menu has a Kids Burger and Kids Combo, and players under 18 need a parent's or guardian's permission for prizes.

qa.q: Is my information private?
qa.a: Your information is used only for your rewards account and is never sold. Texts and emails are opt-in and you can stop them anytime by replying STOP or unsubscribing.

qa.q: Does the app track my location?
qa.a: Only if you allow it, to show how close you are to a StormBurger. Your location stays on your phone.

qa.q: How do I stop marketing texts?
qa.a: Reply STOP to any text, or unsubscribe from emails.

qa.q: Can employees win prizes?
qa.a: Employees and their household members can play but can't win prizes.

qa.q: Where can I see StormBurger's posts?
qa.a: The app has an Instagram section with their latest posts and reels from @stormburger.

qa.q: Who can I ask if the app doesn't answer my question?
qa.a: Ask staff at the counter at your StormBurger location.
